newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana share index firms but investors cautious.
newsitem.headline: Ghana share index firms but investors cautious.

text.p: Ghana's stock exchange index firmed slightly on Wednesday in thin trade as investor caution dominated the market one month from presidential and parliamentary elections, dealers said.
The GSE All-Share Index rose a mere 0.29 points to 367.86 points from 367.57 on Monday.

Just 14,020 shares changed hands compared with 28,410 shares on Monday, 77,710 on Friday and 348,190 last Wednesday, when trading perked up. Offers stood at 1.12 million with demand of 183,920, compared with 1.07 million on Monday against demand of 191,710 shares.
Ghana holds national elections on December 7.

Metalloplastica Ghana Limited (+5 cedis to 135 cedis), Guinness Ghana Ltd (+2 to 244) Pioneer Alumium Factory (+2 to 155), Super Paper Product Co (+2 to 112), Social Security Bank (+1 to 1,046) and Accra Brewery Ltd (+1 to 543) were the risers. ($=1,720 cedis)
